wholePhysicalScope: Named 18-vertex Otowa mansion outline, its documented west carriage entrance and south sunroom, and two exact 2006 Qualla originals.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the open west porch, broad garden bay and dormered roof. Near levels add recessed glazing, sash, ashlar joints, fanlight, rails and the entrance stair.
limitations: The 2006 entrance photograph sets the west arch, shallow external steps, visible stair and fanlight. Most elevations, roof joins, dormer count, railing and small exterior ornament are estimates.

The operator documents arched lower and four-panel upper openings on the south sunroom. The local outline controls its width and projection. The surrounding garden and the rest of the interior are outside the model scope.
The original elevation samples are unchanged. Footings and approach grades are approximate.
